newsitem.title: USA: Diebold says ends agreement with IBM.
newsitem.headline: Diebold says ends agreement with IBM.

text.p: Diebold Inc said Friday it would end an agreement in which International Business Machines Corp sells automated teller machines that it manufactures.
Diebold, which owns 70 percent of a joint venture with IBM set up to make and sell the machines, said it has expanded its sales resources and is now capable marketing directly to customers.
It originally entered into the joint venture to access IBM's "global distribution system."

Under the original agreement, IBM had exclusive distribution rights to InterBold's products in many regions outside the United States. Diebold sold InterBold's products in the United States and managed distribution in other international markets.
Diebold said terms of the joint venture agreement provide for an 18-month transitional period for changes in distribution and marketing responsibilities.
